title: Rahul Gandhi Marks Friendship Day with Gen Z-Style Post
summary: Rahul Gandhi, a student of life, marked Friendship Day by sharing a post on social media featuring the 'Korean finger heart' sign. The post was widely shared and sparked interest in his attempt to connect with the younger generation. On Wednesday, Gandhi posted an image of himself making the gesture, accompanied by a message expressing his desire to learn every day.
summary_points: Rahul Gandhi marked Friendship Day with a social media post featuring the 'Korean finger heart' sign
The post was widely shared and sparked interest in his attempt to connect with the younger generation
